result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of formal crossing infrastructure at the intersection. While the narrow street width likely encourages lower vehicle speeds, the absence of marked crosswalks and curb ramps creates significant accessibility and safety barriers.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: There is no designated crossing area for pedestrians at the intersection, forcing them to share space with vehicles without clear priority.

hazards.name: Absence of curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped transitions at the corner makes the crossing inaccessible for wheelchair users and people with strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the brick building on the right

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt in the roadway and near the sidewalk edge create tripping hazards.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install zebra-style pavement markings to clearly define the pedestrian crossing zone and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install concrete curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to provide an accessible path of travel.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked roadway and sidewalk surfaces to eliminate tripping hazards and improve the longevity of new markings.
